value.rationale: The primary 2026 rigidity theorem supplies only a huge explicit degree threshold even for three monomials. The result proves exactly the finite, uniform cutoff m=4 for all complex homogeneous trinomial supports and monomial-only equality in the progression-free case; this is a natural low-complexity extremal classification, not a numerical tweak or arbitrary parameter slice.
